# Schema catalog

<!-- Generated by scripts/schema_catalog.py. Do not edit by hand. -->

Generated by `scripts/schema_catalog.py`; regenerate with `python3 scripts/schema_catalog.py` from the agentops repository root, and verify with `python3 scripts/schema_catalog.py --check`. The check is local only: it needs the sibling checkouts, which CI does not have.

A definition is a JSON Schema `$id` or `const`, an upper-case source constant, or a TypeSpec/TypeScript literal-typed `schema` property; `emitter` (code that writes the id into a `schema` field it builds) counts only when no repository has a stronger definition. Among several definers, an id prefixed with a repository name (`sprintctl-`, `credctl-`, `cred-broker-`, `sovite-`, `vuoro-`, `agentops-`) is owned by that repository when it is one of them. Mentions in docs, plans, evidence, tests and fixtures are references.

## Roots

Git roots are read from tracked content only: agentops from its working tree (`git ls-files`), siblings from their upstream commit (`main@{upstream}`, else `origin/main`, else `HEAD`), so local clutter and unpulled checkouts do not change the catalog. The source sha makes sibling drift visible to `--check`. The vuoro root covers only `vuoro/contracts`, not the rest of the vuoro repository.

## Vocabulary

Repositories that define schema ids or types (class/model/interface/enum names) containing the term as a word. The owning definition is either the only repository with any such id or type, or the only repository naming an id or type for the term itself (`<qualifier>-<term>/vN`, `<Qualifier><Term>`) when it also defines such an id; anything else is marked owner undetermined.

| Term | Repositories | Owning definition |
|---|---|---|
| lease | agentops, cred-broker, sovite, sprintctl | owner undetermined (agentops, cred-broker, sovite) |
| fence | sovite | sovite: `contracts/execution-v1/main.tsp` (type `Fence`) |
| attempt | agentops, sovite, sprintctl | owner undetermined (agentops, sovite, sprintctl) |
| receipt | agentops, cred-broker, sovite, sprintctl, vuoro | owner undetermined (agentops, cred-broker, sovite, sprintctl, vuoro) |
| qualification | agentops, sovite | sovite: `sovite/qualification.py` (`sovite.qualification/v1`) |

### lease

- agentops: 1 ids (`agentops-project-folder-lease/v1`); 0 types
- cred-broker: 0 ids; 1 types (`CredentialLease`)
- sovite: 0 ids; 2 types (`LeaseService`, `WorkerExecutionLease`)
- sprintctl: 1 ids (`sprintctl-work-lease-basis/v1`); 1 types (`LeaseRefused`)

### fence

- sovite: 0 ids; 1 types (`Fence`)

### attempt

- agentops: 1 ids (`operator-attempt-comparison/v1`); 1 types (`AttemptEnvelope`)
- sovite: 0 ids; 3 types (`RepositoryAttemptContext`, `RepositoryRunAttemptExecutor`, `_AttemptBindingResolver`)
- sprintctl: 3 ids (`sprintctl-effect-attempt-authorization/v1`, `sprintctl-effect-attempt-event/v1`, `sprintctl-effect-attempt-target/v1`); 0 types

### receipt

- agentops: 1 ids (`project-replication-receipt/v1`); 0 types
- cred-broker: 1 ids (`cred-broker-intent-acceptance-receipt/v1`); 4 types (`AcceptanceReceipt`, `ApprovalReceipt`, `ApprovalReceiptSink`, `ReceiptStore`)

- sprintctl: 2 ids (`agent-message-receipt/v1`, `sprintctl-run-invocation-receipt/v1`); 0 types
- vuoro: 0 ids; 3 types (`ContinuationReceipt`, `ReceiptRoutingSession`, `RecordContinuationReceipt`)
